name: rcnt_interrupt_install
rationale: Root-counter interrupt install: ChangeClearRCnt + SysEnqIntRP (enqueue an interrupt handler). Part of the RCnt/timer subsystem (0x80072xxx, timer reg 0x1f801128).

name: rcnt_interrupt_remove
rationale: Root-counter interrupt teardown: ChangeClearRCnt + SysDeqIntRP (dequeue the handler).

name: draw_textured_quad
rationale: Builds and queues a textured 4-point polygon (SetPolyFT4) with semi-transparency + draw mode, appended via AddPrim.

name: sound_positional_voice
rationale: Full 3D voice setup from play_sound: distance (SquareRoot0) -> keys the voice (SsUtKeyOn) and sets per-voice pitch (SpuSetVoicePitch) + detailed volume (SsUtSetDetVVol).

name: cd_find_file_by_name
rationale: Builds a filename (strcat/strcpy) and locates it on disc (CdSearchFile).

name: sound_system_init
rationale: SPU/sound-system init: SpuInitHot + SsSetMVol (master volume) + SsSetTickMode (sequencer tick).

name: scene_load_init
rationale: Per-scene load init from scene_flow_dispatcher: sets up display env/buffers, re-inits subsystems, and loads the scene's resources.

name: actor_skinned_update
rationale: Per-frame update of a skinned/animated actor: skin_transform_bone (skeletal transform), interacts with pickups (nearest_pickup_finalize), spawns drops, plays sounds.

name: level_texture_upload
rationale: Uploads decoded level image/texture data to VRAM during level load (LoadImage + DrawSync), under the LEVEL.RAW decompress orchestrator.

name: load_named_file
rationale: Composes a filename (strcat/strcpy) and loads it via universal_file_loader; helper of level_chunk_loader.

name: level_load_chunks
rationale: Loads a set of level asset chunks (loops level_chunk_loader) after clearing target buffers (memset).

name: pickup_effect_dispatch
rationale: jr-table dispatcher over pickup/effect kinds: routes to grain_pickup_handler, berry homing, drop spawns, with sounds. (Byte-matched dispatcher from v4.5b.)
